tldr: The Sun in Taurus: identity built through steadiness, embodiment, and lasting value.
body: With the Sun in Taurus, the core self strengthens through patience, consistency, beauty, and tangible creation. You are here to build a life that can be felt, held, enjoyed, and trusted.
gift: Endurance, loyalty, grounded confidence, and the ability to make value real.
challenge: Stubbornness, possessiveness, and refusing change because discomfort feels like danger.
note: Authored from approved project planet-through-sign material.
